description: Download the source document (base64) attached to a purchase invoice, sale invoice, journal, or bank transaction. Documents larger than ~5 MB, or when metadata_only=true, return name and size only (the base64 payload is omitted to protect the MCP transport).

entity_type.description: Which record the source document belongs to.

id.description: ID of the record whose document to download.

metadata_only.description: Return only the filename and size, not the (potentially large) base64 contents.

name: get_document
title: Download Source Document
